title: 野生眉怎么选：五官、骨相与个人风格
title_en: Choosing hair-stroke brows: facial features, bone structure and personal style
intro: 项目和仪器是完成设计的工具。真正决定好不好看的，是眉形和你的颧骨、眉弓、五官量感以及日常风格能不能合得上。
intro_en: Tools only execute the plan. What makes brows look right is whether the shape harmonises with your cheekbones, brow bone, facial weight and everyday style.

sections.title: 先看五官量感与风格方向，不套流行模板
sections.title_en: Match facial weight and style instead of copying trends
sections.description: 同样是野生眉，不同人的脸放出来效果完全不一样。眼睛偏大、五官立体度高的人，眉毛如果太细弱容易压不住五官；相反，五官清秀留白多的人，如果盲目套用浓黑大野生眉，哪怕根根分明也会显得抢戏突兀。因此选野生眉第一步不是挑网图，而是先看整体面部比例、眉眼间距和穿衣气质。
sections.description_en: The same brow template looks different on every face. Large, prominent features can make overly thin brows disappear, whereas delicate features with wide facial spacing can look overpowered by heavy, dark strokes. The first step is weighing facial proportions and personal style rather than bringing a viral photo as a fixed mould.

sections.title: 三种常见定制审美路线怎么区分细节
sections.title_en: How details shift across three common aesthetic directions
sections.description: 如果偏爱温柔自然风，眉头通常会留得更松散轻盈，眉峰圆润过渡、眉尾微收贴合眼尾弧度；如果偏好清冷精致风，线条间距会更讲究利落秩序，眉腰和眉峰略带骨感折角；如果本身轮廓偏立体、想要利落英气一点，下缘边界可以走得更干净、上缘保留适度野生杂毛感。在描眉画目，这几种方向都不会用死板边框一刀切。
sections.description_en: A soft, natural brief keeps the brow start airy with a rounded arch and gentle tail; a cool, refined brief tightens stroke rhythm with a subtler peak along the brow bone; a clean, defined brief sharpens the lower contour while leaving subtle natural variation along the top edge.

sections.title: 把日常留刘海、素颜或淡妆习惯一起放进设计
sections.title_en: Factoring in bangs, bare-skin days and light makeup
sections.description: 很多人忽略了生活习惯对眉形的影响：如果你经常留八字刘海或空气刘海，眉峰和眉尾在拨开头发时露不露、会不会被遮住一半，设计前就该考虑进去；如果平时几乎全素颜上班，眉头切忌起得过重，宁可预留一点“补色时再决定加不加浓”的余地，靠后期微调比一开始画过头更安全。
sections.description_en: Everyday habits matter: if you wear bangs, how the arch and tail read both covered and uncovered should be considered beforehand. If you mostly go bare-faced, it is safer to start light around the brow head and refine density at a follow-up rather than over-darkening on day one.

sections.title: 审美偏温柔自然，但私人定制不限单一风格
sections.title_en: A natural baseline that adapts to every individual brief
sections.description: 乐乐老师个人偏爱温柔、自然、原生态，审美带有东方美学的柔和与含蓄，但私人定制从来不把所有客人都做成同一种温和眉。到店设计免费，约30–45分钟，会结合你的原生毛发基础、个人喜好先用眉笔完整试画，沟通满意再定方案，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Lele naturally leans toward soft, restrained Eastern aesthetics, yet bespoke design never forces one style on everyone. During the free 30–45 minute consultation, she tests the shape directly on your face with brow pencil so you can decide before any procedure begins, backed by free touch-ups within one year.
